title: NOVA auto aim
features:
NOVA👾 Auto Aim🔫 Script - Explanation

This is a Roblox Lua script designed as a cheat/hack client (often called a "script" or "exploit") for first-person shooter games. It provides a graphical user interface (GUI) with various combat and visual enhancements. Here's what it does:

---

Core Features

1. Aimbot (Auto Aim)

· Automatically locks onto enemy players within a customizable Field of View (FOV) circle.
· Targets either the Head or Torso (configurable).
· Includes Wall Check (shoots through walls) and Team Check (ignores teammates).
· Can ignore friends via the Ignore Friends toggle.

2. Visual Enhancements (ESP)

· ESP Boxes – Draws colored boxes around enemy players.
· Name Display – Shows player names above enemies.
· Tracers – Draws lines from the bottom of the screen to enemies.
· Distance Display – Shows distance to each enemy in meters.
· Customizable ESP Color – Pick any color for ESP elements.
· FOV Circle – Visual circle showing the aimbot's targeting range.
· FOV 120 – Expands the camera's field of view to 120 degrees.

3. Player Modifications (Movement)

· Walk Speed – Increases movement speed (up to 300).
· Jump Power – Increases jump height.
· Infinite Jump – Allows jumping repeatedly in mid-air.
· Auto Jump – Automatically jumps while moving.
· Spin – Rotates your character continuously at adjustable speed.

4. Miscellaneous

· Wall Transparency – Makes walls semi-transparent to see enemies through them.
· Language Support – Switch between English and Japanese on the fly.
· Discord Integration – Copy a Discord community link directly.
· Notification System – In-game alerts for actions like language switching.

---

How It Works

· Uses RunService.RenderStepped for a continuous loop that updates aimbot, ESP, and player modifications every frame.
· Uses UserInputService to intercept jump requests for infinite jump.
· Uses Raycasting to check if a target is visible (wall check).
· Uses Drawing objects (Circle, Text, Square, Line) for ESP and FOV visuals.
· Uses a UI library (OrionLib) to create the GUI with tabs, toggles, sliders, and dropdowns.

---

Technical Notes

· The script creates a GUI window with tabs:
  · Aim Settings – Aimbot toggles, FOV, aim part.
  · Target – Ignore friends.
  · Player – Movement modifications.
  · Visual – ESP, wall transparency, FOV 120.
  · Info – Discord link.
  · Notice – Version info and patch notes.
  · Settings – Language switcher.
· ESP visuals are created per player and cleaned up when players leave.
· The script includes a configuration system (Config table) to store user preferences.
· The UI is re-created when switching languages, preserving all settings.

---

Important Warnings

⚠️ This script is intended for cheating in Roblox games.

· It violates Roblox's Terms of Service and can lead to account bans.
· Use only in private servers or with explicit permission from the game owner.
· The author (NOVA Script Team) provides this for educational purposes only.

---

Version

· Current Version: 1.6
· Latest Fix: ESP functionality has been optimized and fixed.

---
